requirements.statement: An employee can submit an expense claim with an amount, category, date, description, and receipt

criteria.must: An employee can create a claim with amount, category, date, and description
An employee can attach a receipt to a claim at submission
A submitted claim starts in a pending (submitted) status

requirements.statement: An employee can see the status of every claim they've submitted

criteria.must: An employee sees a list of all claims they submitted
Each claim in the list shows its current status (pending, approved, or rejected)

requirements.statement: An employee can edit and resubmit a claim that was rejected by their manager or finance

criteria.must: An employee can edit the details of a rejected claim
Resubmitting an edited claim returns it to the review process without creating a new claim

requirements.statement: A manager can see a queue of claims submitted by their reports that need review

criteria.must: A manager sees a queue of claims submitted by their direct reports
The queue only shows claims awaiting the manager's review, not claims from employees outside their reports

requirements.statement: A manager can approve or reject a claim, with an optional comment explaining a rejection

criteria.must: A manager can approve a submitted claim
A manager can reject a submitted claim
A manager can attach a comment when rejecting a claim
The employee can see the manager's rejection comment on their claim

requirements.statement: Finance can see a queue of manager-approved claims awaiting finance review

criteria.must: Finance sees a queue of claims that have been manager-approved
The finance queue excludes claims that have not yet been manager-approved

requirements.statement: Finance can approve or reject a manager-approved claim, so only verified claims reach payroll

criteria.must: Finance can approve a manager-approved claim
Finance can reject a manager-approved claim
A finance-rejected claim returns to the employee for editing and resubmission

requirements.statement: Finance can export all finance-approved claims as a downloadable file to load into payroll

criteria.must: Finance can trigger an export that produces a downloadable file
The exported file includes every finance-approved claim not yet exported

requirements.statement: Exported claims are marked so they aren't exported twice

criteria.must: A claim included in an export batch is marked as exported
A claim already marked exported is not included in a subsequent export

requirements.statement: Finance can assign or change each employee's manager directly in the system

criteria.must: Finance can set an employee's manager
Finance can change an employee's existing manager assignment
A claim submitted after a manager change routes to the new manager's queue

requirements.statement: The approval flow is two-step: manager approval, then a separate finance approval, before a claim is eligible for export

criteria.must: A claim not yet manager-approved cannot be exported
A claim that is manager-approved but not finance-approved cannot be exported
